title: Direct Object Pronouns — Spoken Brazilian Portuguese
module: Módulo 7 — Pronomes, relações e estruturas complexas

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “People and objects you saw yesterday” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Brazilian speech often repeats a noun or uses a strong pronoun after the verb; formal writing also uses o/a/os/as.
student.structure: verb + object OR object clitic + verb
student.english_comparison: English me/him/her normally follows the verb; Portuguese clitics differ by register.

model_sentences.en: I saw her yesterday. [formal: object pronoun before the verb]

useful_words.example: Depois, encontrei Pedro e entreguei um livro a ele.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “I saw her yesterday. [formal: object pronoun before the verb]”?
Which sentence expresses “I saw her yesterday. [informal speech]”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

items.hint: I saw her yesterday. [formal: object pronoun before the verb]

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Ontem eu encontrei Ana no mercado. Eu a cumprimentei e conversamos por alguns minutos. Na fala cotidiana, eu também poderia dizer “eu vi ela”, mas em um relatório formal escreveria “eu a vi”. Depois, encontrei Pedro e entreguei um livro a ele. Mais tarde, meus amigos me ligaram para falar do encontro.
questions: Como ele escreveria “eu vi ela” em um relatório formal?
Como você se refere a Ana em uma conversa informal?
Como você escreveria isso de modo formal?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Choose natural everyday spoken forms but recognize formal ones.
review.compare: Vi a Ana / Eu a vi / Vi ela: same referent, different register.

common_mistakes.wrong: Formal report: Eu vi ela na reunião.
common_mistakes.correct: Formal report: Eu a vi na reunião.
common_mistakes.explanation: In formal writing, use the object pronoun a before the verb; vi ela is natural only in informal speech.
Object clitics typically precede a finite verb in neutral sentences.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: Ela me chamou. Eu vi ________ ontem.
Nós vimos o filme. Ela ________ chamou.
Você viu meus amigos? Nós vimos ________ filme.
Eu vi a Ana. Você ________ meus amigos?

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Uma aluna perguntou ao professor sobre o relatório. Ele o leu com atenção e depois enviou uma resposta. Na conversa informal, a aluna disse que viu o professor na biblioteca e falou com ele. O professor explicou que as escolhas de pronomes dependem do contexto e do grau de formalidade.
questions: O que o professor fez com o relatório?
Segundo o professor, de que dependem as escolhas de pronomes?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: Eu tenho uma amiga que mora perto de casa. Ontem vi minha amiga no parque. Em uma conversa, posso dizer “vi ela no parque”. Em um texto mais formal, escrevo “eu a vi no parque”. O objetivo é manter a referência clara. Depois, encontrei outros amigos e os cumprimentei.
questions: Onde o narrador viu a amiga?
Como ele pode dizer isso em uma conversa?
E em um texto mais formal?
O que ele fez quando encontrou outros amigos?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 80–120 words on the topic “People and objects you saw yesterday”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — Você viu um amigo ontem? / Como você se refere a Ana em uma conversa informal? / Como você escreveria isso de modo formal? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

spaced_review.prompt: Before, I lived in a small house.
spaced_review.expected_answer: Antes, eu morava numa casa pequena.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Clitics are unstressed; practice natural phrase rhythm.

mini_reading.translation: Yesterday I met Ana at the market. I greeted her and we talked for a few minutes. In everyday speech, I could also say “eu vi ela,” but in a formal report I would write “eu a vi.” Then I met Pedro and gave him a book. Later, my friends called me to talk about the meeting.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
